item.title: Yvonne Bajela’s $17M Fund Targets EU AI Startups
item.description: Yvonne Bajela closes an oversubscribed $17 million Evertrue Capital I, pledging £350k per deal to back 20 early‑stage AI startups across the UK and Europe.
